primary_title: Neuropeptide CGRP limits group 2 innate lymphoid cell responses and constrains type 2 inflammation
decision_basis: The primary study reports that CGRP combined with IL-33 enhances intracellular IL-5 protein expression in isolated mouse lung ILC2s.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the CGRP plus IL-33 co-stimulus, mouse lung ILC2 context and per-cell intracellular IL-5 measurement; five-day total-supernatant output is reduced by CGRP antiproliferative activity, so no unqualified secretion claim is made; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
